answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 161515 Country: India Title: Is zakah applicable on the money from the sale of land? The land has been sold with the intention to buy a piece of land somewhere else. Also the buyer has not paid all the money yet. Question: Is zakah applicable on the money from the sale of land? The land has been sold with the intention to buy a piece of land somewhere else. Also the buyer has not paid all the money yet. Answer ID: 161515 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 967/776/B=8/1439) If you are already sahib-e-nisab and pay your zakah every year then whatsoever money you have got after selling the land, include it in your wealth and pay the zakah of total money together. And if you are not sahib-e-nisab already then zakah will be wajib on this amount after passing of one complete year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
